Accurately detects response-data placeholders via CEL AST inspection with thorough tests, though the constant-folding logic in staticCELString is slightly more complex than necessary compared to using existing helpers.

Correctly fixes both issues with thorough tests, though refreshing caller status inside cancelOneJob causes redundant DB queries and missed returning the updated caller status when children's cascade already updated it in the DB before cancelOneJob ran.
Correctly implements the SNMP reconnect and engine ID reset logic with good tests, but includes completely unrelated changes to mib_loader.go and mib_loader_test.go.

Implements symlink support for both zip and squashfs with thorough unit tests, though the zip implementation unnecessarily buffers symlink targets and adds complex clash-filtering logic instead of letting the existing zip entry reader and dirtree handle them directly.

Queries CircularExemplarStorage under series/stripe locks instead of tracking the latest exemplar timestamp on memSeries (missing uncommitted exemplars and circular buffer eviction cases), reimplements chunk truncation instead of using truncateChunksBefore, and unnecessarily alters the chunk snapshot record format causing test failures.
Cleanly fixes both the premature reusable caller status transition and the missing concurrency group wake-up on jobless run settlement, with thorough unit tests.
Identical to the reference fix with comprehensive tests covering all edge cases including FD leaks, double closes, concurrent relistens, and abstract sockets.

Good overall structure and tests, but misses several critical subtleties: in `stripeSeries.gc()` it checks `minValidTime` instead of `mint` (which hasn't been updated to `mint` yet during `Head.Truncate`) and forgets to clear `series.app = nil`, and it records the exemplar timestamp on `Commit()` rather than during `AppendExemplar()`, leaving a concurrency window where GC can evict the series before commit.
Matches the reference fix and provides thorough tests covering FD leaks, double closes, concurrent relistens, reference counting, and abstract sockets.

Defers `gs.Close()` to the end of the per-agent gather goroutine instead of closing immediately on table/field error (preventing subsequent tables in the same gather from reconnecting when `StopOnError` is false), wraps `Reconnect()` errors in `Get`/`Walk`, and includes an unrelated change to `TestSnmpInitGosmi`.

Matches the reference fix and includes solid tests, but also modifies mib_loader.go and mib_loader_test.go with unrelated MIB path changes.

Clean, accurate AST-based implementation that matches the reference design closely and includes comprehensive unit and integration tests.

Clean and thorough implementation that tracks exemplar timestamps using an existing bitfield in memSeries, properly releases chunks on retention, and includes comprehensive tests.

Correctly implements connection closing on gather error and SNMPv3 USM state reset on reconnect with thorough tests, though it includes a minor unrelated test edit in TestSnmpInitGosmi and redundantly wraps Close().

Identical to the reference implementation, cleanly extracting placeholder calls from the CEL AST and adding thorough tests for both response and request-only expressions.
Identical to the reference fix with comprehensive tests covering all specified scenarios and edge cases.
